svg.title: Website and publication — read-only server, private browser state
svg.desc: SQLite supplies open rows to Python projection renderers and to a server-only Next.js query shared by the page and public API. RSS and Atom use the same read-only open rows. Dataset status separately checks SQLite aggregates against bounded metadata and a streamed JSON download hash. The website serves fixed generated download files; it does not create them. Browser-local lists never enter the database, URLs, API, or analytics. In versioned deployment mode each server operation resolves the release pointer once. README projections include English and five translations with localized presentation of identical canonical data; only English controls the reviewed-state barrier.
